catl-ess-2026.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. PDF page 9 contains printed pages 15–16. Public capacity-based product designations; orderable part codes are not supplied. eve-lf206.title: EVE Energy LF206 product specifications
eve-lf206.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. Current manufacturer product specification table; no printed document revision. Initial IR lacks an AC/DC method and is held. Standard rates are not silently borrowed as capacity-test conditions.

eve-lf235l.title: EVE Energy LF235L product specifications
eve-lf235l.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. Current manufacturer product specification table; no printed document revision. The model-specific table states 4000 cycles but no life-test protocol. Dimension precision follows the model-specific table (173.936 mm) rather than the rounded headline (173.93 mm). eve-selection.title: EVE MB31 vs. MB30 vs. 280K-V3 in Commercial ESS
eve-selection.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. Manufacturer selection guide. Only MB30 is added. Bare IR is not assigned an AC or DC method. Approximate derived energy in the article is omitted.

calb-filings.title: Prairie Song Reliability Project — Data Request Response 2 Part 6; BESS HMA Rev B
calb-filings.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. Public California Energy Commission filing, TN 266609. The cell is described on PDF page 114, printed HMA page 12, section 2.2. The HMA is watermarked DRAFT. The nominal cell rating is 3.2 V / 314 Ah; 332.8 V refers to the 104S module and is excluded. Publisher: project applicant / public regulatory docket; this is not a CALB datasheet or an independent capacity test. No equivalence to CALB 314Ah Gen2 or L173F314A is assumed.

calb-esie-2026.title: CALB ZHIJIU long-cycle energy-storage cell launch at ESIE 2026
calb-esie-2026.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. Manufacturer launch announcement, dated 2026-04-02 for the 2026-04-01 event. Public capacity-based designations, not unpublished orderable part codes. 392Ah, 588Ah and 661Ah are the three named versions. Exact cathode chemistry, form factor, voltage, dimensions and test protocols are not supplied and are not inferred. Life values are claims with unspecified conditions, not comparable verified test results. Do not combine with older life claims or treat system energy as cell energy.

calb-home.title: CALB current product showcase — 684Ah energy-storage cell
calb-home.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. Manufacturer product showcase as retrieved, no printed revision/date. The 6.8MWh+ figure describes a 20-foot container and is excluded from the cell.
